notes:
## New features
- None in this release.

## Changes
- Holding Shift with the Barrier or Building tool shows the corner or edge snap as soon as Shift is pressed, without moving the mouse first.

## Bug fixes
- Contours no longer fail with "Constrained interpolator does not cover continuous face" at larger grid spacings (seen on a section at 2 m). A thin region where the calculation area meets a shadow line is now checked inside the region rather than on its edge. Every grid spacing from 0.125 m to 16 m was checked on plan and section views.
- The first point of a barrier (or building) now snaps to a building corner or edge when you hold Shift and click, even if the mouse has not moved since Shift was pressed.
- Checked that a barrier joining two buildings leaves no gap at its ends: receivers on the rays grazing each junction stay at the screened level behind the barrier.
